findings.evidence: `GroupPresentation` declares these four fields at GroupPresentation.lean:64-71, but `rg "m(11|12|22)Presentation_(source|sourceLocator|generatorConvention|transcriptionNotes)"` has no hits; the only projection equations in Mathieu.lean are `*_generatorNames` and `*_transcribed`.
findings.fix: Add a characteristic record equation or projection equations for all metadata fields of all three rows, while retaining the existing generator and transcription equations.
findings.issue: `m11Presentation`, `m12Presentation`, and `m22Presentation` are sealed, while their `source`, `sourceLocator`, `generatorConvention`, and `transcriptionNotes` fields have no public equations; downstream auditors therefore cannot inspect most of the manifest row API without unfolding.

summary: The relation API is now exposed, but the sealed rows still hide the provenance metadata they are intended to publish.
